candidate.name: slot_pattern_checker
candidate.description: Extract the 6x6 pattern at a given slot origin (x,y) from the current grid, and compare it against one of the six sample tile patterns. Returns the extracted pattern as a list of hex rows plus a match index (0-5) or -1 if no match. Samples are at fixed positions: row0 y2 (x4,12,20), row1 y10 (x4,12,20), row2 y18 (x4,12,20). Each sample is 6x6 starting at its anchor.

program.source: [[input['grid'][y+dy][x+dx] for dx in range(6)] for dy in range(6)], [s for s in range(6) if [[input['grid'][sy[s]+dy][sx[s]+dx] for dx in range(6)] for dy in range(6)] == [[input['grid'][y+dy][x+dx] for dx in range(6)] for dy in range(6)]]
